# rcheevos (hash part only)

This folder holds the ROM hash code from
[rcheevos](https://github.com/RetroAchievements/rcheevos) v12.1.0
(commit 6755915). RetroArch 1.22.2 uses the same version. The cacher app
uses it to hash each game exactly the way RetroArch does.

Only `include/`, `src/rhash/` and `src/rc_compat.*` are copied. Do not
edit these files. To update, copy the same files from a newer tag that
matches the RetroArch release on the Switch.
